title: Problem Overview
content:
**Erdős Problem #800: Linear Ramsey Numbers**

If G has no two adjacent vertices of degree ≥ 3, then R(G) ≪ n.

**Solution (Alon, 1994):** R(G) ≤ 12n using the probabilistic method.

This includes all subdivided graphs. The result is a special case of the Burr-Erdős conjecture (Problem #163), fully resolved by Lee (2016).

title: The Structural Condition
content:
**vertexDegree, isHighDegree, noAdjacentHighDegree:**

The key condition is `noAdjacentHighDegree G`: no edge connects two vertices of degree ≥ 3. This means the high-degree vertices form an independent set.

Why degree 3? Degree-2 vertices are 'subdivision vertices' that can be inserted along edges to separate high-degree vertices. This captures exactly the class of subdivided graphs.

title: Subdivision Implies Condition (Proved)
content:
**subdivision_implies_no_adjacent_high_degree (proved in Lean):**

If every neighbor of a high-degree vertex has degree ≤ 2, then no two high-degree vertices are adjacent. Proved by contradiction using `omega`.

This verified theorem establishes that subdivided graphs satisfy the structural condition required for Alon's theorem.

title: Ramsey Number Infrastructure
content:
**completeGraph, edgeColoring, isMonochromatic, containsMonochromaticCopy, ramseyNumber:**

R(G) = minimum N such that every 2-coloring of K_N contains a monochromatic copy of G. The Ramsey number is axiomatized along with its specification (ramseyNumber_spec), since formalizing existence via the finite Ramsey theorem requires substantial infrastructure.

**hasLinearRamseyNumber G C** means R(G) ≤ C·n — the best possible growth rate for graphs with Ω(n) edges.

title: Alon's Theorem (1994)
content:
**alon_theorem (axiom):**

If G has no adjacent high-degree vertices, then R(G) ≤ 12n.

The proof uses the probabilistic method:
1. High-degree vertices form an independent set H
2. Randomly embed H into K_N
3. Deterministically extend along paths of degree-2 vertices
4. The constant 12 = 2 (colors) × 6 (probabilistic counting)

**subdivided_graphs_linear_ramsey (proved):** Corollary applying this to subdivided graphs.

title: Degeneracy and Burr-Erdős
content:
**isDegenerateAt G p:** Every subgraph has a vertex of degree ≤ p.

**no_adjacent_high_degree_is_2_degenerate (axiom):** Graphs satisfying the structural condition are 2-degenerate.

**burr_erdos_theorem (axiom, Lee 2016):** Every p-degenerate n-vertex graph has R(G) ≤ c_p · n.

**erdos_800_special_case_of_163 (proved):** Problem #800 follows as the p=2 case of Burr-Erdős.

title: Problem Statement and Solution
content:
**erdos800Problem:** Formalizes the problem as ∀ G with noAdjacentHighDegree, ∃ C, R(G) ≤ C·n.

**erdos_800 (proved):** Solves the problem by invoking alon_theorem with constant 12. This is a fully verified proof modulo the axiomatized Ramsey number and Alon's bound.

title: Summary Theorem
content:
**erdos_800_summary (proved from axioms):**

Combines:
1. **Alon's explicit bound:** R(G) ≤ 12n for all G with no adjacent high-degree vertices
2. **General existence:** erdos800Problem — every such graph has linear Ramsey number

Proved by: `⟨fun V _ _ G h => alon_theorem G h, erdos_800⟩`
